task: Offline body-envelope and measured-motion braking research; source reproduction preserved
promotion: No automatic promotion to DAgger teacher; evaluation gates remain unmet
findings_zh: 全身包络覆盖33个原生碰撞几何，静态反例和接触帧证据均能识别旧11点距离漏掉的几何风险；这不等于策略已经学会避碰。
绕墙研究策略追加1000轮后，1000回合安全成功率从84.4%降至29.1%，物理接触从5.8%升至13.1%，目标停稳保持仍为零。
跨越下蹲研究策略追加1000轮后，安全成功从0/1000提高至129/1000，物理接触从1000降至232回合，但395回合仍触发跌倒判据，目标停稳保持仍为零。
支持入口探针让64/64回合末帧进入SETTLE，但目标停稳保持仍为0/64；仅放宽入口不足以修复行为。
当前是离线专家PPO验证阶段。低速平衡、步态收束和安全到达仍需解决，不能据此推进为可靠蒸馏教师或宣称完成在线感知/CMPC集成。

navigator_override.purpose: Inference counterfactual of the SETTLE entry support gate.
navigator_override.eligibility: Designated active slots only: current mode=BRAKE, previous reference norm<1e-6, current 3D speed<settle_entry_speed.
navigator_override.intervention: Copy feet_contact passed to navigator.advance and set eligible rows to ones only for that call. Real feet_contact payload, contact telemetry and foot-contact reward inputs are not replaced. Termination/success formulas are unchanged. Commands, states and reward values may change as a result of the control intervention.
navigator_override.scope: Tests one gate; not a production fix or evidence of true support. Other modes and slots receive their original contact values.

wall_diagnostic_findings.geometry: All 14 first-contact events have negative new envelope clearance while old eleven-point SDF remains positive; advance warning time was not measured.
wall_diagnostic_findings.entry_bottleneck: Sampled zero-reference BRAKE states do not simultaneously meet speed<0.15 m/s and real dual support. The support-gate counterfactual permits stance but does not establish physical settling or recovery.
wall_diagnostic_findings.causal_limit: Trajectories diverge before observed SETTLE entry. The two early baseline failures occur in DRIVE, so their absence in the probe is not attributed to the settling gate.
wall_diagnostic_findings.not_production_fix: The probe changes a navigator input, not physical support. It may credit a dwell counter for one call and does not relax physical success metrics.

hurdle_diagnostic.scope: Additional 64-episode failure-mechanism diagnostic; separate from the formal 1000-episode recovery cohort
findings: All 18 fall flags in this 64-episode diagnostic trigger the head-height branch while up_z remains positive; pronounced body inclination, high angular speed and downward motion support dynamic loss of balance rather than stable crouching alone.
12 of those 18 episodes contain no recorded obstacle contact; control-step sampling cannot rule out missed physics-substep contact or other external forces.
Recorded first contacts include the head at the upper obstacle and hands/feet at the lower obstacle. Negative conservative envelope clearance is not itself a measured contact.

protocol.cohort: 1000 designated first complete episodes per checkpoint, including early failures; no completion-order selection
protocol.training: 1000 PPO updates x 4096 environments x 20 rollout steps per specialist; fresh optimizer, source weights warmstart
protocol.observations: Known static offline scene geometry, not online sensor observations
protocol.perturbations: Original noise, pushes, RFI and random PD retained
protocol.success: Reached goal at least once with no recorded obstacle contact, monitored self-contact, or source collision, and no fall/invalid termination; original definitions retained
protocol.goal_hold: Current position inside goal plus preceding 0.5 s below 0.1 m/s linear and 0.1 rad/s angular speed; excludes current fall/invalid; does not require dual support, entire interval inside goal, or absence of earlier contact. This physical metric differs from navigator HOLD mode
protocol.arrival_speed: Conditional on goal arrival; non-arrivals are excluded and sample count is reported
protocol.final_speed: Early failures and full-horizon timeouts reported separately in derived terminal_strata

validation.smoke: 4096 environments x 3 updates, excluded from formal budget and evaluation
validation.server_sync: Git bundles, isolated detached worktrees; frozen experiment eebaee0, diagnostic-only 2afd700

limitations: One training seed and one evaluation seed, static training scenes only; no held-out or online occlusion claim.
Same seed is not a paired trial after changed observations, models, RNG consumption and early resets.
Comparison is source parent vs combined geometry/navigation/reward/observation intervention plus 1000 updates; not a component ablation or matched-training baseline.
Observed control-step contacts may omit contacts occurring only within physics substeps.
Conservative body-envelope overlap is not measured physical collision.
Reference deceleration is a configured assumption, not a certified robot braking bound.
64-episode counterfactual diagnostics are separate from formal 1000-episode evaluations and are not production fixes.
